questions.q_en: The side MN of a parallelogram MNOP is produced to Q such that MN = N Q. PQ intersects ON at R. The point R divides ON in the ratio:
questions.solution_en:
Let M, N, O, P be the vertices of the parallelogram with MN and OP as opposite sides.

Since MN = NQ, NQ is an extension of MN and thus MN = N Q.

Consider the triangle ΔMNO and the line PQ intersecting ON at R, Since MN = NQ, triangle ΔMNO and ΔNQO are congruent by the Side-Side-Side (SSS) criterion.

Therefore, ON is bisected by R.

Hence, the point R divides ON in the ratio 1:1.

questions.q_en: From the given options, the largest 5-digit number that is exactly divisible by 78 is:
questions.solution_en:
Largest 5 digits number = 99999

When we divide 99999 by 78, we get 3 as remainder.

So, the largest 5-digit number that is exactly divisible by 78 = 99999 - 3 = 99996 but it is not given in the options.

So, keep subtracting 78 from 99996 until you get the correct option.

99996 - 78 - 78 = 99840

questions.q_en: In a factory of 90 workers, the average weight of the entire factory is 52 kg. If there are 40 male workers in the factory and the average weight of all the male workers is 55 kg, then what is the average weight of all the females?
questions.solution_en:
Total workers in the factory = 90

Average weight of the entire factory = 52 kg

Total male workers in the factory = 40

Average weight of all the male workers = 55 kg

Average weight of all the female workers = [(90*52) - (40*55)]/(90 - 40) = 49.6 kg
questions.solution_hi:

Average weight of the entire factory = 52 kg

Total male workers in the factory = 40

Average weight of all the male workers = 55 kg

Average weight of all the female workers = [(90*52) - (40*55)]/(90 - 40) = 49.6 kg

questions.q_en: A work can be completed by 40 workers in 40 days. If 5 workers leave every 10 days then in how many days work will be completed?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = (40 X 40) = 1600 man - days = 1600 MD

Total work done in first 10 days = (10 X 40) = 400 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 35) = 350 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 30) = 300 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 25) = 250 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 20) = 200 MD

Total work done after 50 days = (400 + 350 + 300 + 250 + 200)

= 1500 MD

Remaining work = (1600 - 1500) MD = 100 MD

Now number of people still working = 15

Number of days taken to finish the remaining work = 100/15 = (6) (2/3) days

So total number of days taken to complete the work = (50 + (6) (2/3)) days

= (56) (2/3) days

questions.q_en: a, b, c and 23 are four distinct numbers and the HCF of each pair of numbers (23, a), (23, b), (23, c) is 23 where a, b, c are each less than 95 and a < b < c. What is the value of (b * c + a)/2?
questions.solution_en:
The four distinct numbers are 23, a, b and c.

HCF is always the factor of the given numbers.

a, b, c should be multiple of 23 as the HCF is 23.

Only possible multiples of 23 are 2, 3 and 4.

a, b and c each are less than 95 and a < b < c.

So, a = 23 * 2 = 46

b = 23 * 3 = 69

c = 23 * 4 = 92

(b * c + a)/2 = (69 * 92 + 46)/2

= (6348 + 46)/2 = 6394/2 = 3197

questions.q_en: A person leaves for his office at 8:45 am everyday and reaches at 9:35 am by driving at 54 km/hr. Today, he left home at the same time but his car broke down at 9:05 am. He took 15 minutes to fix the car and started driving again but at 45 km/hr speed. At what time will he reach his office today?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by the person to travel to his office everyday = 8:45 am to 9:35 am, i.e., 50 minutes.

Hence, distance travelled from home to office = 54 * (50/60) = 45 km

Today, he drove for 20 minutes at 54 km/hr, so distance travelled for 20 minutes = 54 * (20/60) = 18 km

Distance left to cover = 45 - 18 = 27 km

Also, he took 15 minutes to repair the car, then the time when he restarts the car was 9:20 am.

So, time taken to travel remaining distance = 27/45 = 0.6 hr = 36 minutes

Hence, from 9:20 am, he takes 36 minutes to reach office, i.e., he reaches at 9:56 am.

questions.q_en: A pipe can fill a tank in 28 hours. Due to a leakage in the bottom, it is filled in 32 hours. If the tank is 50% full, how much time will the leak take to empty the tank?
questions.solution_en:
Let total capacity of tank = LCM of 28 and 32 = 224 units

Efficiency of pipe = 224/28 = 8 units per hour

Efficiency of leak and pipe = 224/32 = 7 units per hour

Net efficiency of leak = 7 - 8 = -1 units per hour [- shows leak will empty the tank]

50% of total capacity = 224 * ½ = 112 units

Required time = 112/1 = 112 hours.

questions.q_en: A vessel initially contains milk and water in the ratio 4: 1 and 40 litres of the total mixture are taken out and replaced with same amount of water. This process is repeated one more time and now amount of pure milk is decreases by 57.6 litres, then what is the initial amount of mixture in the vessel?
questions.solution_en:
Let initial amount of milk and water in the vessel is '4x' and 'x' litres respectively.

Amount of pure milk in the vessel after 2 such operations when 40 litres of the mixture is replaced with same amount of water = 4x[1 - (40/5x)]2

According to the question:

4x - {4x[1 - (40/5x)]2} = 57.6

4x - {4x[1 - (8/x)]2} = 57.6

4x - 4x[1 + (64/x)2 - (16/x)] = 57.6

4x - 4x - (256/x) + 64 = 57.6

256/x = 6.4

x = 40

Initial amount of mixture in the vessel = 5x = 200 litres

questions.q_en: In grade 11 of a school, 40 students opted for Physics, 17 opted for Biology, and 20 opted for Chemistry. If the total number of students in grade 11 was 60, all of these students opted for at least one of the three subjects mentioned here, and exactly five of these students opted for all these three subjects, what is the probability that a randomly selected student of grade 11 of this school would have opted for exactly one of these three subjects?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of students = 60

Number of students who opted two or more subjects = 40 + 17 + 20 + 5 - 60 = 12

Number of students who opted exactly one subject = 60 - 12 = 48

Probability = 48/60 = 0.8
questions.solution_hi:

Number of students who opted two or more subjects = 40 + 17 + 20 + 5 - 60 = 12

Number of students who opted exactly one subject = 60 - 12 = 48

Probability = 48/60 = 0.8
